name: gcubed-venv-switcher
displayName: G-Cubed VS Code Python venv switcher
description: Switches VS Code Python interpreter venvs through local Unix socket IPC

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist production test && mkdir -p dist production test
scripts.package:test: ../scripts/sync-version --check && npm run clean && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --out test/gcubed-vscode-venv-switcher-test.version.vsix
scripts.package:legacy: ../scripts/sync-version --check && npm run clean && npm run build:prod && vsce package --no-dependencies --out production/gcubed-vscode-venv-switcher.vsix && npm run copy-to-release-files
scripts.package:patch: ../scripts/sync-version --bump patch && npm run clean && npm run build:prod && vsce package --no-dependencies --out production/gcubed-vscode-venv-switcher.vsix && npm run copy-to-release-files
scripts.package:minor: ../scripts/sync-version --bump minor && npm run clean && npm run build:prod && vsce package --no-dependencies --out production/gcubed-vscode-venv-switcher.vsix && npm run copy-to-release-files
scripts.package:major: ../scripts/sync-version --bump major && npm run clean && npm run build:prod && vsce package --no-dependencies --out production/gcubed-vscode-venv-switcher.vsix && npm run copy-to-release-files
